Let  
I = ∫ 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx

Using integration by parts:

I = 3*exp(x)*sin(x) - ∫ 3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx

Now compute ∫ 3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx by parts:

∫ 3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx = 3*exp(x)*cos(x) + ∫ 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx  
∫ 3*exp(x)*cos(x) dx = 3*exp(x)*cos(x) + I

Substitute back:

I = 3*exp(x)*sin(x) - [3*exp(x)*cos(x) + I]  
I = 3*exp(x)*sin(x) - 3*exp(x)*cos(x) - I  
2*I = 3*exp(x)*sin(x) - 3*exp(x)*cos(x)  
I = 3/2*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C

<answer>3/2*exp(x)*(sin(x) - cos(x)) + C</answer>
